title.en: Fit a trend by the method of semi-averages
Use the semi-average line to estimate a trend value

say.en: Before computers, a manager would plot sales on graph paper and draw a line by eye. Can we make that line less of a guess? In this lesson: Describe the free-hand graphic method.
Fit a trend by the method of semi-averages.
Use the semi-average line to estimate a trend value.

body.en: Free-hand (*graphic*) method: plot the series and draw a smooth curve through the middle of the fluctuations. It is simple but subjective. Method of semi-averages: divide the series into two equal halves (omit the middle value if n is odd), find the average of each half, plot each average against the middle of its half, and join the two points. The slope per year is $\frac{\bar{y}_2 - \bar{y}_1}{\text{gap in years}}$. It is objective but assumes a linear trend and is affected by extreme values.

points.en: Odd n: leave out the middle value

narration.en: In the free-hand method we draw the trend by eye. In the method of semi-averages we split the data into two halves, average each half, and join the two averages with a straight line.
narration.kn: ಮುಕ್ತಹಸ್ತ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಣ್ಣಳತೆಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಅರೆ-ಸರಾಸರಿ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಎರಡು ಅರ್ಧಗಳಾಗಿ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ, ಪ್ರತಿ ಅರ್ಧದ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಕಂಡು, ಅವನ್ನು ಸರಳರೇಖೆಯಿಂದ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

narration.en: The board plots six years of sales, finds the two semi-averages, and joins them to give the trend line.

say.en: Plot the sales for six years, 2019 to 2024.
Average the first three years and the last three years.
Plot each average at the middle year of its half: 2020 and 2023.
Join them and extend: that is the trend line. It rises by about 2.67 a year.

problem.en: Fit a trend line by the method of semi-averages to the sales 12, 15, 18, 20, 23, 26 for 2019–2024, and estimate the trend for 2025.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Fit a trend line by the method of semi-averages to the sales 12, 15, 18, 20, 23, 26 for 2019–2024, and estimate the trend for 2025.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Fit a trend line by the method of semi-averages to the sales 12, 15, 18, 20, 23, 26 for 2019-2024, and estimate the trend for 2025.
First half 2019-21: average equals 45 over 3 equals 15, plotted at 2020.
Second half 2022-24: average equals 69 over 3 equals 23, plotted at 2023.
Annual increase equals 23 minus 15/3 equals 2.6667.
Trend for 2025 equals 23 plus 2 times 2.6667 equals 28.33.
So the answer is Trend line through (2020, 15) and (2023, 23); 2025 estimate 28.33.

homework.en: Fit a semi-average trend to 30, 34, 33, 38, 40, 42, 45 (leave out the middle value).

narration.en: Recap. Free-hand method: easy, but subjective. Semi-averages: average each half and join the two points. Slope = difference of averages ÷ years between mid-points.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮುಕ್ತಹಸ್ತ ವಿಧಾನ: ಸುಲಭ, ಆದರೆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿನಿಷ್ಠ. ಅರೆ-ಸರಾಸರಿ: ಪ್ರತಿ ಅರ್ಧದ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಕಂಡು ಎರಡು ಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ. ಇಳಿಜಾರು = ಸರಾಸರಿಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ÷ ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ವರ್ಷಗಳು.
